newsitem.title: USA: Sun Bancorp to buy 11 Bank of NY branches.
newsitem.headline: Sun Bancorp to buy 11 Bank of NY branches.

text.p: Sun Bancorp Inc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to acquire 11 New Jersey bank branches from the Bank of New York Co Inc.
The acquisition would strengthen the bank's presence in Atlantic and Mercer Counties and expand the bank into Middlesex and Somerset Counties, Sun said.
The 11 branches have about $175 million in deposits, the company said.
The transaction, which is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 1997, is subject to regulatory approval and the raising of additional capital, Sun said.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
